title: Official Time
sourceNote: The auto-captions are garbled; the numbers in the video's exercise could not be recovered, so the exercises below are new and based on the rules taught.
objectives: I can ask for the time: Wie spät ist es? / Wie viel Uhr ist es?
I can read and say the time in the 24-hour (official) format
I know when official time is used
I can say 'ein Uhr' instead of 'eins Uhr'

vocab.note: same word for clock and watch

grammar.title: Two ways of telling time
grammar.body:
Time can be read in the **12-hour** or the **24-hour** format. In Germany the **24-hour format** is used in **official** situations: radio, airport, train station, timetables. The 12-hour format is used in **unofficial** situations, for example with friends and family (next lesson).

This lesson is about the official way. Make sure you know the numbers from lessons 3 and 4.
grammar.ar: النظام الرسمي (24 ساعة) في المطارات والمحطات والراديو.

grammar.title: How to ask and answer
grammar.body:
Two questions are common: **Wie spät ist es?** and **Wie viel Uhr ist es?** The answer begins with **Es ist ...**

Official time is simple: say the **hour**, then **Uhr**, then the **minutes**, all as normal numbers.

grammar.title: ein Uhr, not eins Uhr
grammar.body:
For one o'clock you do **not** say *eins*, you say **ein**: **Es ist ein Uhr.** For all other hours you use the normal number: *zwei Uhr, drei Uhr, sechs Uhr ...*

After twelve o'clock you simply keep counting: **dreizehn Uhr** (13:00), **vierzehn Uhr** (14:00), **fünfzehn Uhr** (15:00) and so on, up to **dreiundzwanzig Uhr** (23:00).
grammar.ar: الساعة الواحدة: ein Uhr وليس eins Uhr.

grammar.title: Midnight
grammar.body: In official time midnight (00:00) is **null Uhr**. For minutes after midnight, for example 00:15, you say **null Uhr fünfzehn**.

mistakes.wrong: Es ist sieben Uhr fünf und zwanzig.

pronunciation.tip: 'ö' like the vowel in 'bird' without the r: *zwölf*.

lines.en: Excuse me, what time is it?

tip: Look at your watch several times a day and say the official time aloud in German.

comprehension.q: Which two questions ask for the time?
comprehension.a: Wie spät ist es? and Wie viel Uhr ist es?

comprehension.q: Where is the 24-hour format used in Germany?
comprehension.a: In official situations: radio, airport, train station.

exercises.title: Write the time in words
exercises.instructions: Write the official time as a full sentence beginning with Es ist.

items.a: Wie spät ist es? / Wie viel Uhr ist es?

summary: Ask: Wie spät ist es? or Wie viel Uhr ist es?
Official time uses the 24-hour clock (radio, airport, train station).
Say ein Uhr, not eins Uhr.
After 12:00 keep counting: dreizehn, vierzehn, fünfzehn ...
